canonical_purpose: Keep increasingly autonomous code changes continuously aligned with an explicit machine-readable intent contract.
intended_outcome: A real patch can be translated into observed facts, compared continuously against recovered change intent, and deterministically allowed or refused with reviewable evidence before unauthorized drift reaches merge or deployment.
deployment_reason: Local-first developer tool; no always-on service is required to fulfill the canonical purpose.
truth_boundary: Independent local-first developer tool. No Cursor/Anysphere affiliation, proprietary integration, production deployment, or externally measured Cursor developer-outcome claim is made.
receipt_binding: This receipt binds terminal status to the exact verified source SHA and successful workflow run above. The receipt-only commit must itself retain green verification before merge.
